_comment: The routes that are anonymous ON PURPOSE - the exemption list for the authorization round.
JSON rather than TypeScript because two very different runtimes read it: the inventory script
A `.ts` module is not importable from the first without a build step, and two copies would drift -
and the copy that drifted would be the one nobody read.
`_reason` keys are required for every entry: the value of this list is that a reviewer can
disagree with an entry. A path here is not 'not done yet', it is 'must not have an actor check'.
`compatAliases` records snapshot endpoints that no `@Controller` in the tree declares, so the
inventory can reconcile its own coverage against the API snapshot.

publicByDesign.POST /api/kernel/auth/login: the login route itself - it mints the session everything else uses
publicByDesign.POST /api/kernel/auth/logout: revokes the presented token; anonymous is a no-op, not a leak
publicByDesign.GET /api/health: liveness probe; returns a version and plugin counts
publicByDesign.GET /api/settings: the SPA reads site title and payment switches before anyone logs in
publicByDesign.GET /api/kernel/info: infrastructure summary, no user data; the matrix suggests narrowing it to admin
publicByDesign.GET /api/kernel/plugins: public plugin descriptors, no user data
publicByDesign.GET /api/kernel/permissions: the declared permission catalogue, no user data
publicByDesign.POST /api/auth/register: registration with an invite code - there is no session yet
publicByDesign.POST /api/auth/activate: activation happens before a usable session exists
publicByDesign.GET /api/classes/invite/:code: the register form resolves an invite code before logging in
publicByDesign.GET /api/pet/health: declared public in plugins/pet/plugin.json: plugin id and version only
publicByDesign.POST /api/payment/notify: the payment provider calls this; it cannot carry a session
publicByDesign.POST /api/wechat/login: the mini program's wx.login carries a one-time code and there is no session yet
publicByDesign.POST /api/wechat/bind: completes the login from the ticket plus the account password; the ticket is opaque, single use and expires in ten minutes
